confidence_notes: FX comes from the RBA overview page, as found by search: the 18 Nov 2026 USD rate was 0.6720 USD per AUD. I ran one price search, which returned Jeonju cost-of-living aggregators. They disagree and are undated. Those results covered restaurant meals, beer and cappuccino. The search results did not cover cocktails or wine. I estimated cocktail and wine from the local relationship to beer prices, and they are uncertain. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not check live listings. Jeonju has few hostels, so the hostel prices are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on aggregated Jeonju price indexes, adjusted using other mid-sized South Korean cities such as Daejeon and Gwangju. Jeonju is somewhat cheaper than Seoul, and its hanok-stay tourism pushes mid-range accommodation prices up slightly.
